title: Which Star Wars character are you? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Star Wars character quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Luke, Leia, Han Solo, Yoda, Obi-Wan, Chewbacca, Darth Vader or Rey. Unofficial fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which Star Wars character are you?
lede: A farm kid dreaming of the stars, a rebel leader or a smuggler with a fast ship? Answer 12 questions about adventure, loyalty and trouble to find your Star Wars match.
about: Star Wars has given us some of the best-known characters in film: Luke Skywalker, the farm boy who longs for adventure; Princess Leia, the sharp-tongued rebel leader; Han Solo, the smuggler with a good heart; Yoda, the small and very wise Jedi Master; Obi-Wan Kenobi, the patient mentor; Chewbacca, the loyal Wookiee co-pilot; Darth Vader, the feared enforcer of the Empire; and Rey, the tough scavenger from the desert planet Jakku. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. There are no plot spoilers. If you want to know your lightsaber color, try the lightsaber color quiz on this site. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm or Disney; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Han Solo, Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Chewbacca, Darth Vader and Rey.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
No. It only uses what you learn about each character early in their story.

luke.name: Luke Skywalker
luke.body: You are hopeful, eager and a little impatient for adventure. You see the good in people, you want to make a difference and you grow quickly when you're given a chance. Learn to wait for the right moment and there's nothing you can't do.

leia.name: Leia Organa
leia.body: You are brave, sharp and a natural leader. You say what you think, take charge in a crisis and never give up on a cause you believe in. People follow you because you lead from the front.

han.name: Han Solo
han.body: You are confident, witty and independent, with more heart than you like to admit. You act like you're only in it for yourself, but your friends know you'd never really leave them in a jam.

yoda.name: Yoda
yoda.body: You are wise, patient and calm, with a quirky way of putting things. You don't need to look impressive to be powerful, and people come to you for advice. You know that real strength is inner strength.

obiwan.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
obiwan.body: You are calm, principled and a born mentor. You keep a cool head when others panic and you'd rather talk than fight, but you can defend yourself when you have to. People trust you to do the right thing.

chewbacca.name: Chewbacca
chewbacca.body: You are loyal, strong and big-hearted. You stick by your friends through everything, you're handy in a crisis and you show your feelings loudly. Everyone wants you on their side.

vader.name: Darth Vader
vader.body: You are disciplined, intense and commanding. You have a strong will and you hate disorder, so people take you seriously. Your power is real, so use it to build, not to frighten, and don't let anger make your choices.

rey.name: Rey
rey.body: You are resourceful, determined and independent. You've learned to get by on your own, you can fix almost anything and you're searching for where you truly belong. When you find your people, you're fiercely loyal.
